body:
Goal: the Home Positions card and Money tab show the open positions of all big BTC perp venues (CoinGlass-style total), not only the ones a browser on JIS-NB can reach.

Venue table, measured from JIS-NB on 2026-11-10 by the Super Session with curl and Origin claude.ai:

| Venue | In page now? | Why not |
|---|---|---|
| Deribit, Bybit | yes | - |
| Gate | yes (11-10) | - |
| Hyperliquid | yes (11-10) | - |
| HTX (api.hbdm.com), MEXC (contract.mexc.com) | no | reachable but no CORS: needs the poller |
| Binance fapi, OKX, Bitget, BitMEX, Kraken Futures, BingX | no | ISP DNS block, http 000: needs the poller with DoH |
| CME | no | no free live OI API: skip unless a free source is found |

Build:
- Generalise MyTradingSys/runtime/binance_doh.py (DoH resolve, then pin the IP with SNI) into a host-agnostic helper.
- Write MyTradingSys/tools/live_aid/oi_poller.py, public market data only. Every 30 s it fetches BTC USDT-perp OI per venue, in BTC (state each venue's contract size: SOURCED from the venue docs).
- It writes runtime_data/live_aid/oi_snapshot.js as window.LIVEAID_OI_SNAP = {t, venues: {NAME: {btc, px, t, err}}}. Write it atomically; it is gitignored, never committed.
- The page loads the file every 30 s (a script tag reload, so no CORS is needed). It calls omPush per venue only when that venue's t is under 60 s old. Failure is closed: a stale or missing file reads NOT_IN_DATA, never a guess.
- Add OMV entries for each venue, so the label and shares stay dynamic.

Never: machine DNS changes, Chrome settings, keys, or any order or account endpoint.

Tests:
- Parse one recorded reply per venue into BTC with numbers worked out by hand.
- A stale snapshot must be ignored.
- The poller must survive one venue timing out.
- Restart and reset state: no state file leftovers.

Done when the Home subtitle on JIS-NB lists 8 or more venues with shares, and the Money tab has a column per venue.
done_when: On JIS-NB the Home subtitle lists 8 or more venues with shares and the Money tab has a column per venue; tests pass.
goal: Home Positions and the Money tab show open positions from every big BTC perp venue (CoinGlass-style total), including the venues a browser on JIS-NB cannot reach.

Venue adapters (public OI only) for Binance, OKX, Bitget, BitMEX, Kraken Futures, BingX, HTX and MEXC, giving BTC USDT-perp OI in BTC; contract sizes SOURCED from venue docs
Every 30 s, write runtime_data/live_aid/oi_snapshot.js atomically as window.LIVEAID_OI_SNAP={t,venues:{NAME:{btc,px,t,err}}}
The page reloads the snapshot script every 30 s and calls omPush only for venues younger than 60 s; stale = NOT_IN_DATA
Add OMV columns so the label and shares stay dynamic

a stale snapshot is ignored by the page (replay)
one venue timing out does not stop the others
title: Live Aid OI from every big venue: Python poller (DoH like binance_doh.py) for Binance, OKX, Bitget, BitMEX, Kraken Futures, BingX, HTX, MEXC writes runtime OI snapshot the page reads
